description: Manage walkerOS flows and their previews. List/get/create/update/delete/duplicate flows, or create/inspect/delete preview bundles and mint activation grants (preview_regrant) for testing flow changes on live sites.

content.description: Flow.Json content. Used for create and update.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list response. Only used with the list action.

fields.description: Dot-path selectors for get to return only specific fields.

flowId.description: Flow ID (flow_...) or config ID (cfg_...). Required for get, update, delete, duplicate, preview_list, preview_get, preview_create, preview_delete, preview_regrant.

flowName.description: Used by preview_create — provide one of flowName or flowSettingsId (preview_create also requires flowId).

flowSettingsId.description: Used by preview_create — provide one of flowName or flowSettingsId (preview_create also requires flowId).

includeDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted flows in list results.

limit.description: Max items per page (1-100). Only used with the list action.

name.description: Flow name. Required for create. Optional for update (to rename) and duplicate.

origins.description: Site origins (bare https://host[:port]) to mint a preview activation grant for. Used by preview_regrant; the returned activationUrl targets the first origin.

patch.description: Merge-patch for update (default true). When true, only provided fields are updated.

previewId.description: Preview ID (prv_...). Required for preview_get, preview_delete, and preview_regrant (all also require flowId).

projectId.description: Project ID. Optional filter for list (omit to list all projects). Required for create if no default project set.

sessionId.description: Observe session id — when set, preview_regrant mints an activation/forwarding grant PAIR: the returned activationUrl both activates the web preview and lets the page forward events to the session container (elbPreviewSession param). Pass it to observe server-side hops; omit for a plain web preview.

siteUrl.description: Optional site URL (e.g. https://shop.example.com) for preview_create. When provided, the activation grant is minted for that origin so the returned activationUrl works there.

source.description: What the preview should run, for preview_create: the flow's draft (default) or a deployed version's stored config (kind 'deployment-version' with its deploymentVersionId).

name: flow_manage
title: Flow Management
